context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo Management System fully tested. All 7 backend endpoints work correctly: GET /status, POST /clone, DELETE /clone, POST /reclone, POST /access, GET /accesses, DELETE /access/{id}. Frontend page at /support/demos has all required data-testid attributes. Clone operation takes ~5-10 seconds and copies ~900 documents across 40 collections. Demo school is created with is_demo: true and subdomain 'demo-edunet'. Demo users have is_demo_user: true and expires_at field for expiration tracking.
